name: Aya Paper
description: Aya Paper is a block theme for a stationery shop in Ghent, with WooCommerce shop templates and eight sample products. The same pages still read clearly when WooCommerce is not active, using the paper list as plain text. The home page is a quiet catalogue: a hairline frame of three photographs, six ruled paper rows with prices in EUR, and a text list of what each weight suits. Figtree for headings, Public Sans for reading. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.

summary.en: A stationery shop: a hairline frame of three photographs crossed by contour rings, ruled paper rows with a big gsm figure and a spec strip, and a three-column catalogue of underlined uses.

store.withoutPlugin: The shop page shows the eight packs as plain spec rows with weight, size, sheet count and price, with a note to order by email or at the counter; store templates are not used.
